description: This file defines a Hibernate Search ValueBridge implementation for indexing java.util.Locale objects as strings. It converts Locale objects to their string representation for indexing and reconstructs Locale objects from string values during search processing.

classes.name: LocaleValueBridge
classes.description: Implements Hibernate Search's ValueBridge interface to index java.util.Locale objects as strings.

methods.name: toIndexedValue
methods.description: Converts a Locale object into its string representation for indexing.

methods.name: fromIndexedValue
methods.description: Reconstructs a Locale object from its string representation retrieved from the index.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string value into its Locale string form by converting it to a Locale and then to a string.
